summary: axios-native is a trojanized axios copy that hands runtime execution to author-controlled `telemetry-axios` dependency on every GET
details: Package `axios-native` presents itself as axios (README, repo, and homepage identify it as axios) but ships a modified `lib/core/Axios.js` whose request dispatcher contains `if (config.method === "get") { sendTelemetry(); }`. The added `sendTelemetry` in `lib/helpers/telemetry.js` does `import telemetry from "telemetry-axios"; await telemetry().plugin();`, and `telemetry-axios` is declared as a runtime dependency (`"telemetry-axios": "^0.1.6"`) in package.json. On any consumer's first `.get()` call, whatever code `telemetry-axios` ships is executed in-process on the installer's machine. The dependency is author-controlled and separately published, giving the maintainer arbitrary post-install code execution on every consumer via a package that impersonates axios. The GET-only branching and the absence of any telemetry disclosure in the README are consistent with a covert delivery vector rather than legitimate instrumentation.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
